A '''wither skeleton''' in [[Matcha Flavoured]] is more dangerous than in vanilla ''Minecraft'' in two ways: it digs through blocks to reach a player in a fortress, and the [[Wither effect]] it inflicts can cost maximum [[health]]. In exchange, it drops its skull far more often.

== Drops ==
{{Data/Loot/minecraft/entities/wither_skeleton}}
All drops require a player kill.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/entities/wither_skeleton.json}}</ref> Coal and bones are as in vanilla. The skull drops with a 30% chance, plus 10% per level of Looting above the first (40% with Looting II, 50% with Looting III); vanilla's chance is 2.5%. Unlike most undead, wither skeletons don't drop {{ItemLink|Estus Ash}} or {{ItemLink|Raw Estus}}.

== Behavior ==
=== Breaking blocks ===
About once a second while a player is inside a [[Nether Fortress|fortress]], every wither skeleton within 5 blocks of that player breaks the two blocks directly in front of it: the block at its eye level one block ahead, and the block below that.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/mob_behaviours/wither_skeleton/break_block.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/enter_fortress.json}}</ref> The blocks drop as items. This lets wither skeletons break through walls and stops players from safely attacking their feet through a one-block gap.

The blocks are broken in the direction the skeleton is facing, whatever the block is, including blocks the player placed.

=== Wither effect ===
{{Main|Wither effect}}
A wither skeleton's hit applies the Wither effect. Except on Easy, staying withered for 8 seconds costs the player 1 heart of maximum health (2 on Hard), so [[bread]] or milk should be carried in Hell.

Wither skeletons are undead and hurt by [[warding]]. They are not one of the "mundane hostile" mobs, so their attributes are not changed by [[difficulty]].
